visual.general_description: Color intraoperative photograph of an open abdominal surgical field with gloved hands, retractors, and a black and a blue arrow marking two tissues.
visual.detailed_description: Low-resolution, blurry color photograph of an open surgical field with gloved hands. A large white-gloved hand fills the lower left and another hand holds metal retractor-like instruments at the top and at the right edge. A green surgical drape is visible at the top right corner. In the center-left, a pale pink, smooth, translucent-looking sheet of tissue lies beside red and orange tissue and yellowish lobulated tissue. A black arrow points at the lower edge of the pale pink structure and a blue arrow points at the yellowish lobulated tissue to its right. Red-pink folded tissue lies to the right of the center and a blue cylindrical object lies at the lower right. White cloth or gauze is at the bottom. No panel letters, text, scale or numeric labels are visible.
